title: Sessions no person watches skip the hooks only a person reads, keeping the lease, asks and query-log rows
goal: A session whose environment holds KB_UNWATCHED=1 (set by bl_dispatch.worker_env for every worker of backlog.py dispatch and begin, and by the headless runner launch line the kb-sprint skill gives) runs the lean hook set the operator chose: the launcher _tools/kbpy, given --person before the script, exits 0 at once with no output there, and .claude/settings.json and .claude-plugin/plugin.json mark with --person every hook a person reads (the session-start notice and session_start.py, the digest, horizon, intake, publish, root fetch and red-pipeline hooks, the change router, and kb_hook on UserPromptSubmit) while coord_hook, the querylog capture and launch hooks and kb_hook before WebFetch, Bash and PowerShell (the agent guards) stay unmarked; and python3 _tools/benchmarks.py run session-load --arms A,worker shows the worker arm (arm A under bl_dispatch.worker_env's environment) starting fewer processes than arm A and still writing its coord session lease and query-log work rows

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import csv, os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
B = os.path.join(T, 'bin'); os.mkdir(B)
open(os.path.join(B, 'claude'), 'w').write('#!/bin/sh\nexit 1\n')
os.chmod(os.path.join(B, 'claude'), 0o755)
ENV = dict(os.environ, PATH=B + os.pathsep + os.environ['PATH'])
out = os.path.join(T, 'out.csv')
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/benchmarks.py', 'run', 'session-load', '--arms', 'A,worker', '--reps', '1', '--out', out],
                   capture_output=True, text=True, env=ENV, timeout=1800)
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open(out, encoding='utf-8'))) if os.path.exists(out) else []
shutil.rmtree(T, ignore_errors=True)
assert p.returncode == 0, ('run session-load --arms A,worker exit', p.returncode, p.stderr[-400:])
val = {(r['case'], r['arm'], r['metric']): float(r['value']) for r in rows if r['scenario'] == 'session-load'}
for case in ('idle all', 'working all'):
    w, a = val.get((case, 'worker', 'spawns_per_min')), val.get((case, 'A', 'spawns_per_min'))
    assert w is not None and a is not None and w < a, ('a worker session starts no fewer processes than arm A', case, w, a)
assert val.get(('working all', 'worker', 'lease_written')) == 1, 'the worker session wrote no coord session lease'
assert val.get(('working all', 'worker', 'work_rows'), 0) > 0, 'the worker session wrote no query-log work rows'

import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import json, os, subprocess, time
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_dispatch
env = bl_dispatch.worker_env('op-00000000')
assert env.get('KB_UNWATCHED') == '1', 'bl_dispatch.worker_env does not mark a worker unwatched'
E = dict(os.environ, KB_UNWATCHED='1')
t = time.perf_counter()
p = subprocess.run(['sh', '_tools/kbpy', '--person', '_tools/querylog.py', 'digest', '--hook'], input='{}', capture_output=True, text=True, env=E, timeout=60)
dt = time.perf_counter() - t
assert p.returncode == 0 and not p.stdout.strip() and dt < 0.5, ('a person-only hook in an unwatched session does not exit at once', p.returncode, p.stdout[:200], round(dt, 2))
ev = json.dumps({'hook_event_name': 'PreToolUse', 'tool_name': 'WebFetch', 'tool_input': {'url': 'https://example.com/'}})
q = subprocess.run(['sh', '_tools/kbpy', '_tools/kb_hook.py'], input=ev, capture_output=True, text=True, env=E, timeout=60)
assert q.returncode == 0, ('kb_hook on a WebFetch call in an unwatched session', q.returncode, q.stderr[-200:])
s = json.load(open('.claude/settings.json', encoding='utf-8'))
cmds = [(ev, g.get('matcher', ''), h['command']) for ev, gs in s['hooks'].items() for g in gs for h in g['hooks'] if 'kbpy' in h['command']]
keep = ('coord_hook.py', 'querylog.py capture', 'querylog.py launch')
for ev, m, c in cmds:
    if any(k in c for k in keep) or (ev == 'PreToolUse' and 'kb_hook.py' in c):
        assert '--person' not in c, ('a hook unwatched sessions keep is marked person-only', ev, m, c)
    else:
        assert '--person' in c, ('a person-only hook is not marked', ev, m, c)
skill = open('skills/sprint/SKILL.md', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert [ln for ln in skill.splitlines() if 'KB_UNWATCHED=1' in ln and 'claude -p' in ln], 'the kb-sprint skill gives no headless runner launch line that sets KB_UNWATCHED=1'

gates.question: Should sessions no person watches (dispatched workers, headless sprint runners) run with fewer hooks, and which? Decide from the paid session-load record

gates.recommendation: Lean: person-only hooks exit, coord and query-log hooks kept
